items.title: States Are Leading the Way on AI Safety Regulation
California names expert panel to shape AI oversight and potential frontier model ‘kill switch’
items.summary: California Governor Gavin Newsom has appointed four technology and policy experts to advise the state on tighter oversight of frontier AI, including proposals for independent verification inside AI labs and a potential emergency “kill switch” for advanced models.
